changes.description: Increase brass cabinet pulls from 28 to 32 for the two extra island drawers.
Remove the dining pendant because the client's grandmother's chandelier will hang over the dining table.
Reduce the marble side tables in the living room from two to one.

constraints: The client must confirm the revised quote before any of these changes take effect.
